requirements.title: Payment data security review
requirements.description: The release must have a completed security review, with no unresolved critical or high-severity findings and explicit sign-off.

requirements.title: Critical payment-path regression coverage
requirements.description: Automated regression tests must cover card authorization, retries, refunds, and idempotency; the latest run must pass.

requirements.title: Production observability and alerting
requirements.description: Dashboards and actionable alerts for authorization errors, latency, and duplicate charges must be deployed and verified.

requirements.title: Rollback and recovery readiness
requirements.description: A rehearsed rollback plan, database compatibility check, and named on-call coverage must be recorded before release.

requirements.title: Customer and support communications
requirements.description: Customer-facing release notes and support guidance must be reviewed and ready to publish.
